title: Build a sandbox VM for a legacy app
scenario: Work order #2290 — The accounting trainer needs a virtual machine on the lab host LAB-HV01 to test LedgerClassic 9, an old accounting program. The vendor supports it only on LegacyOS 7 (32-bit), and it has not had a security update in years, so the VM must not be able to reach the office network or the internet. Name the VM ACCT-TEST and give it 2 virtual processors and a 60 GB virtual disk. Give it as much memory as the guest operating system can actually use, but always leave at least 6 GB of the host's memory unassigned for the host itself. Virtual disks belong on the VM storage drive, never on the operating system drive. Install the guest OS, keep a clean point to return to before LedgerClassic goes in, then install the app and prove it runs. The existing VM, PRINT-TEST, is in use by another trainer all day.
tasks: Work out the memory and storage the new VM can have on this host.
Create ACCT-TEST to match the work order.
Install the guest operating system and save a clean point to return to.
Install LedgerClassic 9 and prove it runs.
Do not disturb anyone else's work on the host.
hints: Start with the host summary: how much memory is installed, and how much is already assigned?
16 GB installed, 6 GB already assigned to PRINT-TEST, and 6 GB must stay with the host. That leaves a ceiling for the new VM.
A 32-bit operating system cannot use more than 4 GB of memory, however much you assign.
The ticket says the VM must not reach the office network or the internet. Read the three network types carefully.
Take a snapshot after the guest OS is installed and before LedgerClassic goes in. That is the clean point to return to.
Do not shut down, change or delete PRINT-TEST. Someone is using it.
Finish with the LedgerClassic test inside ACCT-TEST.

checks.label: ACCT-TEST created from the LegacyOS 7 (32-bit) ISO with 2 processors
checks.pass: The VM has the right name, guest operating system and processor count.
checks.fail: The VM does not match the work order: it should be named ACCT-TEST, built from the LegacyOS 7 (32-bit) ISO, with 2 virtual processors.

checks.practice: Memory is sized correctly for the guest and the host
checks.label: Assigned 4 GB of memory
checks.pass: 4 GB is the most a 32-bit guest can use, and it leaves 6 GB unassigned for the host.
checks.fail: The memory is not right. A 32-bit guest can use at most 4 GB, and with 6 GB already assigned to PRINT-TEST and 6 GB reserved for the host, 4 GB is also the most this host can spare. Less wastes nothing but limits the VM; more is wasted and breaks the host rule.

checks.practice: The VM is stored where it belongs
checks.label: 60 GB virtual disk stored on the D: VM storage drive
checks.pass: The 60 GB disk is on the VM storage drive.
checks.fail: The virtual disk is not as the work order asked: 60 GB, on D:. Putting VM disks on the operating system drive can fill it and stop the host.

checks.practice: The sandbox cannot reach other networks
checks.label: Network set to Internal (isolated)
checks.pass: An internal network keeps the unpatched guest away from the office network and the internet.
checks.fail: The VM can reach other networks. Bridged joins the office network and NAT reaches the internet; an unpatched sandbox needs the Internal (isolated) network.

checks.practice: There is a clean point to return to
checks.label: Took a snapshot after installing the guest OS and before installing the app
checks.pass: The trainer can revert to a clean guest at any time.
checks.fail: There is no snapshot of the clean guest. Take one after the OS is installed and before LedgerClassic is installed, so testing can always start over from a known state.

checks.practice: Other people's work was not disturbed
checks.label: Left PRINT-TEST running and unchanged
checks.pass: You did not interrupt the VM another trainer was using.
checks.fail: You shut down, changed or deleted PRINT-TEST while another trainer was using it. The new VM fits on the host without touching it.

checks.practice: Confirmed the app works after the last change
checks.label: Ran the LedgerClassic test successfully after the last change
checks.pass: LedgerClassic ran inside ACCT-TEST after your final change.
checks.fail: You did not run a successful LedgerClassic test inside ACCT-TEST after your last change.
